sources:
  - name: nppes

transcript.content:
1	version: 2
2	
3	models:
4	# Intermediate
5	  - name: specialty_mapping
6	    description: >
7	      Maps Medicare specialties to the NUCC taxonomy, deduplicating Medicare specialties by prioritizing the most specific specialty. 
8	      It joins the Medicare specialty crosswalk data with the NUCC taxonomy, ensuring that Medicare specialties are appropriately matched 
9	      or otherwise defaulting to NUCC specialization or classification where necessary.
10	
11	    columns:
12	      - name: taxonomy_code
13	        description: "Taxonomy code from the NUCC taxonomy."
14	        tests:
15	          - not_null
16	      - name: medicare_specialty_code
17	        description: "Medicare specialty code, prioritized to ensure only one specialty per provider taxonomy code."
18	        tests:
19	          - not_null
20	      - name: description
21	        description: >
22	          Cleaned description of the specialty. Based on Medicare provider supplier type description where available, 
23	          otherwise defaults to NUCC specialization or classification.
24	        tests:
25	          - not_null
26	
27	  - name: taxonomy_unpivot
28	    description: Unpivot provider taxonomies from NPPES data
29	    columns:
30	      - name: npi
31	      - name: taxonomy_col
32	      - name: taxonomy_code
33	      - name: switch col
34	      - name: taxonomy_switch
35	
36	
37	  - name: provider
38	    description: >
39	      Combines provider details from the NPI source table with their primary taxonomy and associated specialty. 
40	      It provides a comprehensive view of the provider, including business practice location details, taxonomy, and specialty.
41	
42	    columns:
43	      - name: npi
44	        description: "National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider."
45	        tests:
46	          - not_null
47	          - unique
48	      - name: entity_type_code
49	        description: "The entity type code indicating whether the provider is an individual or an organization."
50	        tests:
51	          - not_null
52	      - name: entity_type_description
53	        description: "Description of the entity type based on the entity_type_code ('Individual' or 'Organization')."
54	        tests:
55	          - not_null
56	      - name: primary_taxonomy_code
57	        description: "The primary taxonomy code for the provider."
58	        tests:
59	          - not_null
60	      - name: primary_specialty_description
61	        description: "The specialty description for the provider's primary taxonomy code."
62	        tests:
63	          - not_null
64	      - name: provider_first_name
65	        description: "The first name of the provider (formatted in title case)."
66	        tests:
67	          - not_null
68	      - name: provider_last_name
69	        description: "The last name of the provider (formatted in title case)."
70	        tests:
71	          - not_null
72	      - name: provider_organization_name
73	        description: "The legal business name of the provider's organization (formatted in title case)."
74	      - name: parent_organization_name
75	        description: "The parent organization name of the provider (formatted in title case)."
76	      - name: practice_address_line_1
77	        description: "First line of the provider's business practice location address (formatted in title case)."
78	        tests:
79	          - not_null
80	      - name: practice_address_line_2
81	        description: "Second line of the provider's business practice location address (formatted in title case)."
82	      - name: practice_city
83	        description: "The city of the provider's business practice location (formatted in title case)."
84	        tests:
85	          - not_null
86	      - name: practice_state
87	        description: "The state of the provider's business practice location."
88	        tests:
89	          - not_null
90	      - name: practice_zip_code
91	        description: "The postal code of the provider's business practice location."
92	        tests:
93	          - not_null
94	      - name: last_updated
95	        description: "The last update date for the provider's information."
96	        tests:
97	          - not_null
98	      - name: deactivation_date
99	        description: "The deactivation date of the provider's NPI, if applicable."
100	      - name: deactivation_flag
101	        description: >
102	          A flag indicating whether the provider's NPI has been deactivated (1 if deactivated, 0 if not).
103	        tests:
104	          - not_null
105	
106	  - name: other_provider_taxonomy
107	    description: >
108	      Handles provider records that do not indicate a primary taxonomy code. It uses logic based on the order and switch 
109	      flags of the taxonomy codes to determine the most likely primary taxonomy for a provider, adding primary flags to the taxonomy codes.
110	
111	    columns:
112	      - name: npi
113	        description: "National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider."
114	        tests:
115	          - not_null
116	      - name: taxonomy_code
117	        description: "Taxonomy code associated with the provider."
118	        tests:
119	          - not_null
120	      - name: medicare_specialty_code

    , cast(npi_deactivation_date as date) as deactivation_date
    , case
        when npi_deactivation_date is not null then 1
        else 0
      end as deactivation_flag
from npi_source
     left join primary_taxonomy
     on npi_source.npi = primary_taxonomy.npi
